items.docs: This API operation retrieves the configuration settings for all Single Sign-On (SSO) providers that have been configured in Grafana. When called, it returns a comprehensive list containing the settings and parameters for each SSO provider, such as OAuth, SAML, or other authentication mechanisms that are available in the system.
